sections.body:
The archive is going to SLOW DOWN here, because the corridor DESERVES it and because of what it MEANS. Waluigi's filing says so. Waluigi's commentary is OBEYING the filing, which is a first, and Waluigi wants CREDIT.

The hallways of the fey manor are in surprisingly GOOD shape overall, with rather minimal wear or DAMAGE. The plaster is CRACKED in places. The wood has seen BETTER days. Everything is CLEAN, and polished as well as it can be.

A VAST carpet runs in all directions, well worn from the footsteps of COUNTLESS beings, but CLEAN — and it rests upon polished MARBLE that is EQUALLY worn and EQUALLY well cared for.

WARM light fills the hallways from NUMEROUS glowing glass orb lanterns affixed to the WALLS.

Now HOLD that against everything else in this filing. There is a shambling mound EATING the library. There are TWO TREANTS in the planning room. There is something in the KITCHEN that ATE a person, and a Revel DOWNSTAIRS that has been playing the SAME REEL for WEEKS, and an overgrowth coming up through the FLOORS of a house that has been dying by INCHES since before they ARRIVED.

And somebody is still polishing the MARBLE.

Somebody is still trimming the lanterns. Somebody walked this carpet with a BRUSH this WEEK, in a WAR, while the walls were producing VINES, and got the DUST out of a rug that has been walked FLAT by a THOUSAND YEARS of feet.

Waluigi has AUDITED institutions in COLLAPSE. Waluigi KNOWS what a failing house looks like from the INSIDE: the accounts stop first, then the MAINTENANCE, then the STAFF, and the last thing to go is ALWAYS the lie that everything is FINE. This house has done it in the OPPOSITE ORDER. The staff are DYING. The accounts are a MAP WITH PINS IN IT. And the lanterns are *WARM*.

Waluigi wants the READER to understand that Waluigi does not hand out that kind of sentence LIGHTLY. Waluigi has a PROFESSIONAL OPINION — Waluigi's note says so, Waluigi's note is HEADLINED so — and the opinion is this: you can measure a household's MORALE by the objects NOBODY is required to CARE about. The marble is POLISHED. The lanterns are LIT. Whatever else is TRUE of this house, its staff have not yet agreed to let it LOOK like what it is.

Hjumpik walked down the MIDDLE of that carpet with a warhammer over his SHOULDER and did not remark on ANY of it.

Waluigi remarked on all of it, SILENTLY, AT LENGTH — Waluigi's filing, Waluigi's words, and Waluigi wants it KNOWN that silent lengthy remarking is Waluigi's HARDEST discipline — and filed it under the heading the archive has been CIRCLING for THREE sessions now: the Overgrown Manor is not a house LOSING a war. It is a house *KEEPING STANDARDS* during one, which is a DIFFERENT and much SADDER thing.

Waluigi is not going to shout over that sentence. Waluigi already SHOUTED the whole SECTION. The sentence can STAND.

sections.heading: Hjumpik Danger Deldkur (The Middle Name Is A Lie)
sections.body:
Two guards were SHUTTING a door. Not guarding it — *SHUTTING* it, BOTH shoulders, the way you close something that is PUSHING BACK. Waluigi wants the DISTINCTION, because the distinction is the WHOLE SITUATION.

Hjumpik asked, REASONABLY, whether there was a way around it. He wanted to FLANK.

"The creation in them ate someone," one of the guards said.

Everybody stopped.

"Wait." Hjumpik put a hand FLAT on the door beside the man's SHOULDER. "You *SAW* someone eat someone?"

They had. They did not want to describe it, and they described it ANYWAY, in the COMPULSIVE way people do. Waluigi has TAKEN such statements. Waluigi has been such a statement. Waluigi is not elaborating.

Then the second guard jerked his chin further down the hall, toward the NOISE, and gave them the shape of the NEXT room before they ASKED for it.

A battle was going on in the KITCHEN.

"There's a commander in there. Red." He CAUGHT himself. "He — she. She's preparing the DINNER."

"Dinner," Waluigi said.

"She will EAT YOU ALIVE." He said it with the FLAT conviction of a man REPEATING something he has been TOLD and has NEVER tested. "Like the monsters do. She's the heir's GREATEST soldier."

Waluigi would like the record to REFLECT that this is the second time in this house that a woman has been DESCRIBED to them before she was MET — and that the first time, the description was of a LADY, and the REALITY was a PLANT WEARING HER FACE. Waluigi keeps a FILE on described women. The file currently reads: ZERO FOR ONE. Waluigi is WATCHING this one.

"We're both going to die on our own terms," the guard added, with a kind of EXHAUSTED gallantry.

"That's not the Hjumpik way," said Hjumpik.

The guard looked at him.

"Huh? What's that?"

"My NAME."

And his FRIEND — the OTHER guard, the one who had been HOLDING the door with his WHOLE BODY — made a small STRANGLED noise and went slightly TO PIECES, in the manner of a man whose reserves have been SPENT for some HOURS and who has just been handed one absurdity TOO MANY.

*WAH!* The dwarf's ENTIRE PERSONALITY is a load-bearing JOKE and he deploys it as a MORALE WEAPON. TWO MEN holding a door against something that EATS PEOPLE, and he broke them with the ETYMOLOGY of his OWN NAME. It WORKED. That is the HORRIFYING part. It WORKED. Waluigi's note, Waluigi's caps, Waluigi STANDS by the horror.

He got the door to the mushroom room OPEN. BOTH of them went in.

They got DRUNK.

"Going up can be DANGEROUS," one of them said from INSIDE the mushroom room, in the loose CONFIDING voice of a man who has recently discovered he has FEELINGS.

Hjumpik did not break stride.

"That's MY middle name," he said. "Hjumpik *Danger* Deldkur."

Waluigi wants to enter into the archive, FORMALLY and WITH CITATIONS, that this is NOT TRUE.

The Deldkur line runs Piktor Deldkur the THIRD — DECEASED, ONE ARM, GREAT WARRIOR — and before him a second and a FIRST that NOBODY in THREE PLANES has heard of and that Waluigi INTENDS to find. There is no Danger in it. There is no Danger on ANY document, guild roll, contract, or BAR TAB Waluigi has ever seen the man SIGN — and Waluigi has seen a NUMBER of his bar tabs, because Waluigi has PAID several of them.

He MADE IT UP. Standing in a corridor, at an hour with NO NAME, in a house where the marble is POLISHED and something in the kitchen EATS PEOPLE, a SOBER dwarf invented a MIDDLE NAME to make two frightened DRUNK guards feel BETTER about a STAIRCASE.

The guards did not react. They were, at this point, EXTREMELY occupied with the mushroom room.

Waluigi REACTED. Waluigi wrote *DANGER (invented, in situ)* in the MARGIN and UNDERLINED it — and then sat with the UNDERLINE for a moment, because there is a VERSION of that joke that is a man SHOWING OFF and there is a VERSION that is a man DOING A JOB, and after four sessions in this manor Waluigi has STOPPED being able to tell them APART. He does the BIT. The room gets LIGHTER. Somebody who was about to STOP MOVING keeps MOVING.

FORTY volumes and Waluigi still does not know whether Hjumpik is funny ON PURPOSE.

"Let's go," he said. They LEFT, and went UPSTAIRS.

Waluigi, AUDITOR-GENERAL, CERTIFIES the following: Hjumpik Deldkur has no middle name. He has a WARHAMMER, a GRANDFATHER, a GUILD he will not name, and a habit of manufacturing EXACTLY as much courage as a corridor REQUIRES. The INVOICE for that service has NEVER ONCE been issued.

sections.heading: The Best Strategy In The Manor Is Being Run Out Of A Stockpot
sections.body:
"Ow. OW, ow." Red was going at her work with the sound of somebody who has burned the SAME TWO FINGERS more than ONCE this shift. She looked up. "Who are you? Did orange guy send you?"

The HEIR. ORANGE GUY. The archive notes the manor's chain of COMMAND in FOUR SYLLABLES. Waluigi has written SHORTER chains. Waluigi has written LONGER chains. Waluigi has NEVER written a chain where the entire upstairs government fits inside a GREETING.

"You're here to stop the plant monsters?" Hjumpik asked.

"No. No." She waved the question off with a LADLE. "We're here to *COOK*." And then, with what Waluigi can only describe as PROFESSIONAL SATISFACTION: "The plants LOVE this."

She held up what she was MAKING.

It WITHERED in her hand.

NOT wilted. *WITHERED* — went GREY and SLACK between her fingers in about a SECOND AND A HALF, the green going out of it like HEAT out of a POKER — and she watched it do that with the expression of a woman CHECKING A SAUCE. Waluigi has SEEN that expression. Waluigi has FELT that expression. Waluigi's expression is BETTER DRESSED.

Hjumpik got it BEFORE Waluigi did. Waluigi will ADMIT that IN WRITING. He looked at the GREY thing in her fist, and then at the POTS, and then at the DOORS the guards had been holding SHUT, and something REORGANISED behind his eyes.

The food is BAD *ON PURPOSE*.

She is not defending the kitchen from the overgrowth. She is *PROVISIONING* it. She is running POISON out through the one system this house has NEVER STOPPED OPERATING — the SERVICE, the TRAYS, the DINNER — at the SCALE a great house does everything, and she is CALLING it dinner because that is WHAT IT IS.

*WAH!* The BEST strategy in this manor belongs to the COOK. Everyone UPSTAIRS has a MAP WITH PINS IN IT. She has a SERVICE that already RUNS, a SCHEDULE the enemy already TRUSTS, and a POISON the enemy already EATS. Waluigi's note, Waluigi's caps, and Waluigi wants the COMPARISON UNDERLINED: the war room has PINS. The kitchen has a DELIVERY SYSTEM. Pins do not wither plants. DINNER withers plants.

She handed Hjumpik a POT of the slop. It SMELLED like a POND in AUGUST.

"You will stay for DESSERT," she told him. Not a question.

Something was WRIGGLING in an oven. It was wriggling with INTENT, and it had a RHYTHM, and EVERY SINGLE ONE OF THEM decided INDEPENDENTLY and SIMULTANEOUSLY NOT TO ASK. Waluigi was there. Waluigi did not ask. Waluigi is an ARCHIVIST, Waluigi's ENTIRE FUNCTION is asking, and Waluigi LOOKED at that oven and chose CONTINUED EXISTENCE. Waluigi STANDS by the choice. Waluigi has FILED the choice.

"Maybe later," Hjumpik said.

"...Wait." Waluigi had been READING THE ROOM, which is Waluigi's FUNCTION. "What's in that door?"

Red produced a KEY from somewhere in the APRON.

"Oh, THIS?" She turned it over. "Nothing much. A SHORTCUT to the MAIN ROOM."

*NOTHING MUCH.*

Waluigi needs the reader to APPRECIATE the sentence. The only direct route in the HOUSE lives in the cook's APRON POCKET, and she announced it the way another woman announces PARSLEY. Waluigi has AUDITED treasuries with WORSE inventory control and BETTER ANNOUNCEMENT DISCIPLINE.

Waluigi took her running sheet off the prep table on the way out, because Waluigi is WHAT Waluigi IS. The dinner service sheet, AS TAKEN, is EXHIBITED with the filing. Waluigi EXHIBITS. Waluigi ALWAYS exhibits.

And Waluigi's aftermath leaves the thread OPEN, DELIBERATELY: she has a working COUNTER-STRATEGY, an operating SUPPLY LINE, and a KEY to the main room — and NOBODY has yet asked her the OBVIOUS question, which is whether the HEIR knows what she is COOKING. Waluigi is asking it HERE. Waluigi EXPECTS no answer. Waluigi EXPECTS the question to SIT THERE, in the filing, GLOWING, until somebody BRAVER than Waluigi picks it up.

sections.heading: The Fungus Tests Clean And The Men Do Not
sections.body:
A guard was telling ANYONE who would listen that the mushroom room had NO EFFECT on him WHATSOEVER.

He was VERY CLEAR about it. UNAFFECTED. COMPLETELY FINE. SHARP as a tack, in fact, SHARPER than usual, and he would THANK you NOT to imply otherwise.

His eyes were BLOODSHOT TO THE RIM.

Waluigi is going to let those two facts SIT NEXT TO EACH OTHER without further comment. COMPLETELY FINE. BLOODSHOT TO THE RIM. Waluigi has AUDITED witnesses. Waluigi has filed CONTRADICTIONS. Waluigi has rarely had one DELIVERED so neatly, in UNIFORM, VOLUNTEERING ITSELF.

Hjumpik NOTICED. Waluigi WATCHED him notice — the small still moment, the beat where a dwarf DECIDES not to say a thing — and then he asked, MILDLY, about the other one. The COLLEAGUE. There had been two.

"Where did he go?"

"He's in the mushroom room." CHEERFULLY. "Want to see?"

They went and LOOKED, because the archive GOES AND LOOKS. The room was WARM and LOW and smelled like a cellar in the GOOD way. Hjumpik CROUCHED, picked up a mushroom, turned it OVER, and SNIFFED it.

FINE. ORDINARY. A MUSHROOM.

That is the part Waluigi CANNOT make fit, and Waluigi has been TRYING since. The mushrooms test CLEAN. The men who spend time in the room do not. Something in there is having an EFFECT that is not in the fungus, and the fungus is what everyone is looking at, and Waluigi has a HORRIBLE suspicion that this is the DESIGN.

Waluigi FLAGS the sentence, not the mushroom. Waluigi's note, Waluigi's emphasis, Waluigi's whole professional posture in ONE clause: LOOK AT THE SENTENCES, NOT THE FUNGUS.

Hjumpik walked away, then turned around and went to the BATHROOM instead — which sounds like a JOKE and was in fact the SINGLE MOST PRODUCTIVE DECISION OF THE NIGHT. Waluigi's filing, Waluigi's ranking, Waluigi DEFIES anyone to produce a more productive bathroom trip in FORTY VOLUMES.

There was a guard OUTSIDE the bathroom, standing at PARADE REST, and he informed them with REAL PRIDE that he was guarding the LADY OF THE MANOR.

"You have been here for FIFTEEN MINUTES," said Toad Lee.

The guard's face did something COMPLICATED.

"What? She said TWENTY MINUTES ago—"

"What did the lady LOOK like?"

"She was HIDING her face."

NOBODY said anything for a MOMENT. In the WALLS, faintly, the vines TICKED.

Hjumpik KNOCKED. Then OPENED the door.

A PLANT MONSTER came out of the BATHROOM.

And Waluigi would like the archive to NOTE that Waluigi did not hesitate, deliberate, or CONSULT. A spark of fire left Waluigi's hand BEFORE the thing had finished EMERGING — NOT one of Waluigi's LARGER works, a SMALL PRECISE UNKIND one — and it went into the CENTRE of the mass where a HEART would be if the thing had BOTHERED with one.

It turned to ASH. ALL of it, AT ONCE, STANDING UP — and then not standing up.

NOBODY had guarded a LADY. A guard had stood at a door for FIFTEEN OR TWENTY MINUTES protecting the PRIVACY of a thing that was HIDING ITS FACE BECAUSE IT DID not have one — and he had been *PROUD* of it, and Waluigi has NO JOKE for that.

Waluigi's file on described women now reads: ZERO FOR TWO. Waluigi is CLOSING the file. Waluigi is BURNING the file. From now on everyone in this house is a PLANT until they produce DOCUMENTATION.

They investigated the ROOM. And in the TOILET, Waluigi found SOMETHING.

"Is it POOP?" Hjumpik asked, from the DOORWAY, with the DIRECTNESS that makes him such a POOR diplomat and such an EXCELLENT witness.

It was not. It was a VIOLET FUNGUS — SQUAT, PURPLE, unmistakably ALIVE, and REGARDING them.

Hjumpik crouched to its LEVEL.

"Do you speak ENGLISH?"

The fungus did not.

He turned to Waluigi. "Can you TRANSLATE this?"

"*HUH?*" Waluigi drew Waluigi's SELF up. "I am a FIELD ARCHIVIST, not a TRANSLATOR."

"Maybe Waluipedia has it."

And he pulled the TABLET OUT, RIGHT THERE, crouched over a TOILET in a FEY MANOR at TWO IN THE MORNING, and started searching Waluigi's ENCYCLOPEDIA for a violet fungus PHRASEBOOK.

*WAH!* He LOOKED IT UP. In the MIDDLE of an operation, over a TALKING MUSHROOM in a TOILET, the dwarf consulted the archive as a WORKING REFERENCE. That is what it is FOR. FORTY volumes and its FIRST FIELD DEPLOYMENT is a fungus in the PLUMBING. Waluigi has NEVER been PROUDER or MORE INSULTED. Waluigi is HOLDING both feelings. Waluigi has TWO HANDS.

"I'll be RIGHT BACK," he said, and went to find the GUARDS.

LATER — after the bathroom, after the ASH — he came back to the mushroom room guard, and the missing colleague had RETURNED, and the two of them had this exchange in front of them:

"Hey. The MUSHROOMS didn't have any EFFECTS."

"Oh." A pause of EXACTLY THE WRONG LENGTH. "I didn't think you would come back THAT SOON."

Hjumpik: "Where were you?"

"Field observations."

FIELD OBSERVATIONS. Two words, in a CORRIDOR, from a man with a HIDDEN DOOR BEHIND HIM. Waluigi flags the SENTENCE, not the mushroom: "I didn't think you would come back that soon" is not the language of a man who was somewhere INNOCENT. It is the language of a man who had a WINDOW and MISJUDGED it. The fungus is a DECOY and Waluigi will be FILING on this again.

sections.heading: The House Returned Us To Our Own Doorstep
sections.body:
Hjumpik went back to the mushroom room guard. A SECRET HATCH opened somewhere behind the PANELLING, and the missing colleague came back through it, and they had the *field observations* exchange the archive has ALREADY FILED.

Then Hjumpik asked the only question that MATTERED.

"Why should we TRUST you?"

The guard held up FINGERS. THREE of them. He had them READY, which is ITSELF a FINDING. Waluigi AUDITS readiness. NOBODY has references READY unless they have NEEDED references before, OFTEN, under PRESSURE.

ONE. Aurelian is HELPING.

TWO. Orangus Cornelius.

Three — and here he WARMED UP, and LEANED IN, and became briefly the HERO of his OWN account — "I stopped WARIO. Actually, I did QUITE A BIT."

Let Waluigi take these IN ORDER. The FIRST is a woman currently FOLDED INTO A GOLD RING in Hjumpik's POCKET, who has helped NOBODY in some WEEKS. The SECOND is a NAME the guards of this house have REFUSED to say OUT LOUD since the SITTING ROOM, delivered HERE as a *REFERENCE*. The THIRD is a claim made by a VERY LARGE NUMBER of people, ALMOST ALL of whom are LYING, and NONE of whom have EVER produced a RECEIPT.

The three credentials, AS TRANSCRIBED, are EXHIBITED with the filing. Waluigi EXHIBITS. Waluigi ALWAYS exhibits. Waluigi ESPECIALLY exhibits EVIDENCE THAT CONVICTS ITSELF.

"Fine," said Hjumpik.

The guard knocked THREE TIMES. A door OPENED in a wall that had NO DOOR IN IT.

Waluigi NOTES, WITHOUT COMMENT, that Hjumpik had been GIVEN the instructions FIRST, had TRIED it himself, and had FAILED. THREE KNOCKS. He got it WRONG. The house does not open for people who have been TOLD how; it opens for people it KNOWS. Waluigi's filing, Waluigi's STRUCTURAL note, and Waluigi wants it UNDERLINED: this house has a FUNCTIONING hidden infrastructure that opens for its OWN PEOPLE and returns STRANGERS to where they STARTED — and they have been walking around INSIDE it for WEEKS congratulating THEMSELVES on their STEALTH.

The passage was ONE-BEING-WIDE. They went in SINGLE FILE — wall on BOTH shoulders, the smell of DUST and OLD PLASTER, somebody's lantern throwing their shadows forward in a LONG JOINTED ROW — and they scurried through it with the particular INDIGNITY of important people in a CRAWLSPACE. Waluigi was THERE. Waluigi SCURRIED. Waluigi does not scurry WELL. Waluigi's DIGNITY filed a COMPLAINT.

There were OTHERS in there. WAITING. In the DARK. They did not explain themselves and NOBODY asked.

And then the passage let them out.

Back where they STARTED.

ALL of them. The whole party, the guards, the WAITING figures, out into the same stretch of corridor they had ENTERED from, with the same warm lantern light on the SAME well-cared-for MARBLE.

A secret passage that returns you to your OWN DOORSTEP is NOT a fault in the house. It is the house's OPINION, expressed in ARCHITECTURE, of everyone currently walking around INSIDE it. They have been in this manor for WEEKS and it has decided they are FURNITURE. Waluigi's note. Waluigi's ARCHITECTURE. Waluigi is FURNITURE-PROOF and intends to PROVE IT.

That is when Waluigi STOPPED being able to do this POLITELY.

sections.heading: Waluigi Opened The Door Himself
sections.body:
"You know WHAT," Waluigi said. "We have been going in CIRCLES. And we are *LOSING*."

Hjumpik turned around.

"Look at how many people we have LOST to your INCOMPETENCE," Waluigi said — and Waluigi did not stop, because it had been BUILDING since the marching order and the lost-dog remark and the fungus in the TOILET — "And that Toad too — he just sits around and FOLLOWS you. At least the FEY in this house *CARE* about it."

"We killed one of the BIG plant monsters," Hjumpik said. "Right?"

"A HALF-DEAD one. That was ALMOST KILLED by the fey residents BEFORE we got there."

"Do you want to just run around and FIGHT things," he said, "or THINK before you act?"

And here is where Waluigi wants the archive to SLOW DOWN, because the argument TURNS OVER on this line and Waluigi is the one who TURNED it.

"Thinking has led us THIS FAR," Waluigi said. "We're not dead. But if we DON'T act, they reach the HEIR, and we are STUCK with the plants FOREVER."

"No. NO, no." Hjumpik put a hand out — not at Waluigi, at the CORRIDOR, at the whole GREEN length of it. "We can'T fight every battle. *LOOK at these guys.*"

"I ONE-SHOT that shrub ALMOST ten minutes ago."

"Remember the GOBLINS stabbed it and it DIED." The dwarf's voice went FLAT in a way Waluigi had not heard from him BEFORE. "I don't think that's saying much."

Which was TRUE. Which is EXACTLY the point Waluigi had made HIMSELF, in this same corridor, about this same shrub, and which Waluigi now NEEDED not to be TRUE.

"Then if they're THAT WEAK," Waluigi said, "we should TAKE THEM ON."

And Waluigi OPENED THE DOOR.

Waluigi wants that recorded in the ACTIVE VOICE, because Waluigi has spent this entire filing recording OTHER PEOPLE'S decisions and this ONE WAS WALUIGI'S. NOT the dwarf's. WALUIGI'S. His hand came up as Waluigi reached past him — TOO SLOW, or slow ON PURPOSE, or slow because he had spent the NIGHT being told by Waluigi that THINKING was what was killing them — and it CLOSED on the AIR where Waluigi's sleeve had been.

The monster was standing in the MIDDLE of the room, SURROUNDED by people. It was not half dead. NOTHING about it was half dead. It turned its WHOLE MASS toward the doorway, FOUND them in it, and ROARED — and the sound went through the polished MARBLE and UP into the warm LANTERN LIGHT and OUT into a house that has been keeping its STANDARDS for a THOUSAND YEARS.

Hjumpik looked at WALUIGI. NOT at the thing in the ROOM. At WALUIGI.

"Since WHEN did you care?"

And Waluigi heard Waluigi's SELF answer, in the CORRIDOR, OVER the noise, BEFORE Waluigi had cleared it with ANY part of Waluigi that handles POLICY:

"I can't afford not to care ANYMORE."

The Revel played on DOWNSTAIRS. The filing ends here, in a doorway WALUIGI OPENED, MID-ROAR.

The positions had reversed by the end and never reversed back. Hjumpik counselled restraint and Waluigi forced a fight, and the archive records both facts without flinching. The library is held by no one; the reclamation is a sentence in this filing rather than a fact on the ground. What changed was volume eleven, and a finger under the line.

RECOMMENDATION: NONE. There is no recommendation. The violet fungus is UNCATALOGUED and UNTRANSLATED. The circular passage has NOT been RE-ENTERED. The standing order — UPSTAIRS, the main room, the HEIR, the plan built on a tactical map over a WHOLE NIGHT — has now been abandoned for a FULL SESSION and replaced with NOTHING. Next filing begins in that DOORWAY, and it is WALUIGI'S.

WAH.

commentaries.title: The Lava-Bridge Ambush and the Blue Luigi
commentaries.subtitle: In Which I Knock On Bowser’s Gate, Lose An Informant Over A Waterfall, And Name A Marked Deck Out Loud
commentaries.filed: 5 Aethel, 1040 BF — filed from the desk, at length, five years late and still furious
commentaries.pullQuote: I went to that gate on a hunch, and came back with a prisoner, a plan, and a grief. The arithmetic does not cover that part.
commentaries.standfirst: The embassy night did not end at the embassy, and I have a full cut to prove it — every knock, every fireball, all nine seconds of Mister L, both Luigis, and the birth of the Cheater’s Gambit, with opinions attached to ALL of it.

sections.heading: It Starts With A Gate, A Hunch, And Breath Coming Out White
sections.body:
I stand at the gate of Bowser's compound two hours after the embassy job, and the first thing the filing tells you is the temperature. Breath coming out WHITE. Hands gone NUMB inside the gloves. I am cold, I am tired, and I am two hours past my dignity — a deficit I report the way other men report expenses, precisely and with receipts, because Waluigi believes suffering should be ITEMIZED. (It should. Waluigi is correct. The entire archive runs on itemized suffering, and Waluigi is its CHIEF ACCOUNTANT.)

This is the SMALL compound. I say so immediately, and I am GLAD I said so, because the filing needs you to understand: this is not the castle. This is the walled annex tucked inside the Mushroom Kingdom proper, the little volcanic blister of ground where Bowser does the business he does not want trucked all the way back to Darkland. I have driven past its turnoff a DOZEN TIMES without stopping. Twelve drive-bys. ZERO visits. Waluigi's ratio stands at TWELVE TO ZERO, and Waluigi wants that ratio appreciated, because it tells you everything about how tonight goes: a man who has avoided a door twelve times does not knock on it the thirteenth time for FUN.

And knocks are coming. Oh, the knocks are COMING. Waluigi can FEEL them coming. But first I stand in the cold dirt road with the engine ticking as it cools behind me — I hear the engine ticking, I ALWAYS hear the engine, Waluigi's hearing is EXCELLENT and Waluigi's car is OLD — and stare at iron bars under a sky the color of a bruise going purple. A bruise going purple. Waluigi wrote that simile, Waluigi STANDS BY that simile, and Waluigi will FIGHT any critic who calls it overwrought, because I was THERE and the sky was exactly that color and I do not hallucinate weather. (Waluigi hallucinates MOTIVES. Weather Waluigi reports straight.)

Then comes the sentence that starts the whole night: *"Luigi... wouldn't come here."*

I say it OUT LOUD. To NOBODY. Testing the shape of it, the filing says, and I LOVE that phrase — testing the shape of it — because that is what Waluigi does with EVERY insane idea, Waluigi holds it up and turn it around and check it for cracks, and this idea is insane ON ITS FACE. Luigi HATES Bowser. The filing gives you the hatred in triplicate — landlord, tax collector, tooth that only hurts at night — and Waluigi is PROUD of that list, Waluigi POLISHED that list, that list took Waluigi longer than the drive over. Luigi would no sooner run to Bowser's gate, I tell you, than I would run to Wario for a LOAN. (I have run to Wario for a loan. ONCE. I do not discuss it. The filing does not mention it. I mention that the filing does not mention it, which is my way of mentioning it WITHOUT filing it.)

*"Right? There's no way he came here."*

And then — the FEET. My feet do not go back to the car. Waluigi makes a GREAT DEAL of the feet, as Waluigi SHOULD, because the feet are the whole filing in miniature: the doubt kept losing, the gate kept standing there, and the gut kept pulling like a fish on a line. Waluigi is an auditor. Doubt is Waluigi's WHOLE TRADE. And the doubt LOST. To FEET. I have never once in my life driven away from a door like that, I say so MYSELF, I call it my WORST HABIT — and I am RIGHT, it is my worst habit, and I am ALSO right that it is my BEST habit, and Waluigi contains MULTITUDES, mostly cold ones, standing on dirt roads at night.

The last place anyone would look, the filing says, is the first place a terrified man goes. I KNEW that the way you know a song. What I did NOT know — what NOBODY knew, what the SONG did not say — was that the song had a second verse. And the second verse was wearing my informant's FACE.

sections.heading: Three Knocks And The Worst Security Hire In Koopa History
sections.body:
The gate stands SHUT. I get up close and it is WORSE than from the road — iron bars sunk into stone posts, a little security window at head height with a shutter, and above it all a wall-walk where NOBODY IS WALKING. Waluigi clocks the empty wall-walk IMMEDIATELY. Waluigi ALWAYS clocks the empty wall-walk. An unmanned wall is either an invitation or a LAYOFF, and I have been on the receiving end of BOTH, and Waluigi can tell you they feel EXACTLY THE SAME right up until they don't.

I weigh my options the way a man weighs a coin he suspects is fake. I LOVE that simile TOO. Waluigi is on FIRE with similes in this filing — bruise skies, fake coins, fish on lines — and I want it NOTED that I produced all of them while HYPOTHERMIC. Cold Waluigi is POETIC Waluigi. Warm Waluigi just does paperwork. NOBODY quotes warm Waluigi.

Options: drive away and keep hunting the backroads, or walk up to that window and announce myself to Bowser's security apparatus like a guest arriving for DINNER. The gut decides before the pride finishes OBJECTING. Waluigi's gut has OVERRIDE AUTHORITY. Waluigi's gut has OVERRIDDEN Waluigi's better judgment so many times that my better judgment has started filing COMPLAINTS. The complaints are PENDING. The gut does not CARE.

*"Alright... fine. I'll knock."*

THREE knocks. *Tok tok tok.* Sharp enough to sting through the glove. I count the knocks — THREE, the filing is EXPLICIT, Waluigi counts them the way Waluigi counts EVERYTHING — and the sound goes into the gatehouse and DIES there. And then I stand in the silence imagining every guard in the compound mustering with SPEARS, which is Waluigi's anxiety doing Waluigi's anxiety's FAVORITE HOBBY, and then the shutter scrapes back and a face appears in the low lamplight, blinking.

*"Huh? Woah."* The guard sits up. *"What's with the getup?"*

WHAT'S WITH THE GETUP. I have been asked about the OUTFIT by a man whose ENTIRE JOB is standing behind IRON, and I am STUNG, and I will be STUNG about it for YEARS, and I am RIGHT to be stung, because the overalls are CLASSIC and the hat is ICONIC and the mustache is LOAD-BEARING. But I do not defend the fit. I lean INTO the bars, cross my arms in what I HOPE reads as menace rather than cold — the filing says so, I CONFESS it, I am HONEST about my MENACE-TO-COLD RATIO — and say it:

*"I need to speak to Bowser."*

The guard LAUGHS IN MY FACE. Out LOUD. *"Ha! You really think Bowser is in THIS compound? Come on! You wouldn't last two minutes in Bowser's castle."*

TWO MINUTES. The guard gives me TWO MINUTES. I will REMEMBER this number. I will CARRY this number around for the REST OF THE NIGHT the way other men carry a WALLET. And I SNAP — *"I don't care about Bowser's castle!"* — stung EXACTLY where the guard aimed, because the guard has EXCELLENT AIM, I will GRANT him that much, the man is a SNIPER with DISRESPECT, and Waluigi RESPECTS the AIM.

Then comes the BUTTON. I slam my palm, I DEMAND answers, and the guard — the guard who LAUGHED, the guard with the SNIPER DISRESPECT — reaches sideways WITHOUT LOOKING and CLICKS A BUTTON. *"You know what — he IS here. Second floor. Lava bridge. Take the warp pipe."* And the gate OPENS.

I KNEW it was wrong. I say so MYSELF, I UNDERLINE it, I want it UNDERSTOOD: no bribe, no threat ANSWERED, no PAPERS — one slammed hand and the most secure annex in the kingdom is giving out DIRECTIONS like a CONCIERGE. The hinges did not even SQUEAK. Waluigi HEARD the hinges not squeaking. A gate that well-oiled is a gate that gets USED, and used OFTEN, and NOBODY had told me WHO BY. I walked through ANYWAY. I ALWAYS walk through anyway. It is my WORST habit. (See SECTION ONE. Waluigi CROSS-REFERENCES. Waluigi is a PROFESSIONAL.)

sections.heading: A Room With One Axe In It Is Not A Room
sections.body:
The warp pipe stands past the gate with heat shimmering off its rim, and I GRIP the edge — hot even THROUGH THE GLOVE — and look DOWN into orange dark that breathes upward at me like a SLEEPING ANIMAL. Waluigi's pipes are ALWAYS fauna. Waluigi has been THROUGH enough warp pipes to FURNISH a zoo, and I report that they breathe, they SWALLOW, they SPIT, and they NEVER apologize. The filing says this one took me the way warp pipes take everyone: ALL AT ONCE and with NO APOLOGY. Waluigi has filed COMPLAINTS about pipe apologies. The complaints are PENDING. The pipes do not CARE.

*"The second floor... lava bridge?"*

I say it like a QUESTION. I am HOPING it is a question. It is NOT a question. It is an ITINERARY. I JUMP anyway, because Waluigi has a WORST HABIT (see SECTIONS ONE and TWO, I CROSS-REFERENCE RELENTLESSLY), and the heat climbs past me in LAYERS — copper and sulfur and hot stone, THREE LAYERS, Waluigi COUNTED, Waluigi counts LAYERS the way other men count SHEEP — and then I am SPAT OUT sideways onto rock that radiates warmth straight through my BOOTS.

And there it is. The bridge. Narrow stone over a lake of slow-bubbling lava. Air rippling. Dark falling away on BOTH SIDES into heat-haze. The far shore a SMEAR of orange. And at the far end, on a ledge, upright in the stone, glinting under flickering light:

An AXE. Just SITTING there. WAITING.

Waluigi catalogues the ABSENCES first, because Waluigi is an AUDITOR and absences are EVIDENCE: no Bowser, no guards, NO furniture, NO torches, NO throne, NO reception committee of ANY KIND. Waluigi lists SIX missing things. Waluigi wants you to feel the EMPTINESS the way Waluigi felt it — as a ROOM WITH ONE OBJECT IN IT, which is a room BUILT AROUND that object, and NOBODY builds a room around an axe because they ran out of CHAIRS. *"What the hell...?"* I say, and my mouth goes DRY, and EVERY instinct I own — auditor, athlete, survivor of Wario's business ventures, THREE instincts, Waluigi has them BADGED — stands up AT ONCE and shouts the SAME THING.

Waluigi REGRETS coming. Waluigi says so PLAINLY: alone, unarmed, at night, on a HUNCH. FOUR regrets. Waluigi ITEMIZES. (Waluigi ALWAYS itemizes. See SECTION ONE. My cross-references have CROSS-REFERENCES.)

And the filing's aside at this point is me at my MOST me: a weapon displayed as the SOLE furnishing of a lava bridge is not DECORATION, it is a PROPOSITION. Somebody set that bridge the way you set a MOUSETRAP. And the CHEESE. Was WALUIGI.

WALUIGI WAS THE CHEESE. Waluigi said it. Waluigi FILED it. Waluigi wants it READ BACK AT WALUIGI'S RETIREMENT DINNER. And then — THEN — from the dark at the pipe end of the bridge, SOMEBODY CLEARS HIS THROAT. And I know the voice before it finishes the FIRST WORD, because I have spent the WHOLE EVENING shouting at it.

The filing does not name the voice yet. The filing makes you WAIT. Waluigi is CRUEL. Waluigi KNOWS Waluigi is cruel. I learned PACING from being KEPT WAITING by Wario for a decade, and I am PASSING THE TRAUMA DOWN THE LINE. The next section opens with the line. THE line. The thesis-statement-that-is-not-a-greeting. And I am going to make you turn the PAGE for it, because Waluigi is a SHOWMAN, and the show is the ONLY thing standing between me and SCREAMING.

sections.heading: The Informant Throws A Fireball, Or: Performance Reviews
sections.body:
*"You thought the Koopa worked alone?"*

THE LINE. I whirl, and there is LUIGI — at the pipe end of the bridge, Fire Flower BURNING in his fist, face twisted into something I have NEVER SEEN on him before. Not fear, not EXACTLY. Fear with its TEETH BARED. Waluigi's description. Waluigi's TEETH metaphors. I am TERRIFIED and LITERARY at the SAME TIME, which is Waluigi's DEFAULT SETTING, and then there is NO TIME for literature anymore because the FIREBALL is already COMING. Straight at MY CHEST. Hissing orange-white across the gap. NO warning. NO monologue first. My informant — my WEEPING, farm-confessing, back-door-escaping INFORMANT — just THROWS KILLING FIRE at my STERNUM like I am a TARGET DUMMY that OWES HIM MONEY.

I throw myself SIDEWAYS. The fireball crisps the air by MY EAR — *hisssss-CRACK* — and bursts against the bridge behind me, and I land hard on one knee and one glove on HOT STONE, heart hammering against my ribs LIKE IT WANTS OUT. Waluigi's heart is ALWAYS trying to ESCAPE. Waluigi's heart has FILED for TRANSFER three times. DENIED. The heart stays. The heart HAMMERS.

*"LUIGI?!"* is all I get out at first, and honestly? RESTRAINT. Me showing RESTRAINT. Give Waluigi CREDIT. Waluigi could have said MANY things — Waluigi KNOWS many WORDS, Waluigi knows words in DIALECTS — and I go with the NAME, because sometimes the name is the WHOLE SENTENCE.

Then the frozen second. The lava bubbling. The axe GLINTING. The heat pressing down LIKE A HAND. (Waluigi's similes. STILL firing. The man is being SHOT AT and the similes do NOT STOP. This is PROFESSIONALISM. This is also possibly a MEDICAL CONDITION. I have NOT been evaluated. I REFUSE evaluation. I evaluate OTHERS.)

And then I STRIDE FORWARD — forward, TOWARD the man with the FIRE, because Waluigi's survival instincts and Waluigi's FEELINGS have NEVER MET — and deliver the HURT. *"You're WORKING with them?! You led me here on purpose!"* And: *"I trusted you! After all the time we've known each other! You know how much this hurts, right? Finding out I've been betrayed by someone I actually liked?"*

SOMEONE I ACTUALLY LIKED. I SAID IT. On a LAVA BRIDGE. To a man HOLDING FIRE. I confessed FONDESS under BOMBARDMENT, and I want the record to show I did NOT take it back LATER, I DOUBLED DOWN, I put it in the FILING, I am STILL not taking it back, and if that embarrasses me then I will be EMBARRASSED IN TRIPLICATE.

Luigi's answer comes back LIKE A SLAP: *"You TRUSTED me? You locked me up in your car and demanded answers!"*

And we are OFF. The argument the CAR did not finish gets finished on the BURNING BRIDGE. Kidnapped! Prisoner! LIAR, over and OVER again! *"I was just trying to find out the TRUTH!"* Tears standing BRIGHT in Luigi's eyes, REFLECTING THE FIRE. Knuckles WHITE around the stem. And then Luigi does the thing my report describes THREE TIMES because I could not BELIEVE IT ONCE:

Luigi BITES the Fire Flower. BITES it. Like a man BITING A COIN. Petals CRUSHED. Sap RUNNING. The glow surging up his THROAT and into his EYES. And my aside is pure Waluigi: the Fire Flower is NOT PRODUCE. It is ORDNANCE WITH PETALS. Whatever Luigi became in the next ten minutes STARTED IN HIS TEETH.

*"You don't understand ANYTHING! I wasn't trying to betray you! I was trying to protect everyone from getting hurt WORSE than they already are!"*

WORSE. Waluigi SNAGS on that word like a HOOK. Worse than WHAT? The filing's own note asks it — worse than the CAR? Than the FARM? Than something Luigi KNEW and STILL would not SAY? I accused Luigi of holding ANSWERS, and on that bridge Luigi CONFIRMED it — not with a confession, but with ARITHMETIC. There was a WORSE. Luigi had MEASURED it. Luigi has STILL not told me the NUMBER. And Waluigi is STILL ASKING. Waluigi will ask FOREVER. Waluigi has put the question on Waluigi's TOMBSTONE DRAFT. (Draft THREE. Waluigi revises OFTEN.)

sections.heading: The Shut Door, Or: Doors Are The Whole File
sections.body:
*"The Koopa was the only one who didn't lock me out... everyone else abandoned me."*

I STOP SHOUTING. For the FIRST time that night, I STOP. The filing says so, and I UNDERLINE it, because Waluigi stopping is an EVENT — Waluigi stopping is a FIRE ALARM going QUIET — and what stops me is the SHAPE of the sentence. The inventory of the ABANDONED. Recited LIKE A LEDGER. And Waluigi KNOWS ledgers. Waluigi SPEAKS ledger. I HEARD my own NATIVE TONGUE coming out of a man holding a BITTEN FLOWER on a BURNING BRIDGE, and it got past my anger the way the fireball got past my GUARD. (Too SOON for that joke? I do not CARE. I process TRAUMA through CALLBACKS.)

*THE* Koopa. I SNAG on the ARTICLE. Not A koopa — THE Koopa. DEFINITE article. Capital-T in MY NOTES. Waluigi talks about articles the way other men talk about WITNESSES, and I am RIGHT TO, because Luigi talked about this creature the way you talk about a LANDLORD who took you in when the bank changed the LOCKS: with the particular loyalty of a man with EXACTLY ONE creditor left. I NEVER got a name. I NEVER got a description. The paper does NOT say. NOBODY in this building has authenticated a SHELL, a SPIKE COUNT, or a MOTIVE. Two hours of shelter bought more allegiance than a LIFETIME of brotherhood — and THAT, I say, is the sentence this whole night TURNS ON. Waluigi is RIGHT. Waluigi is ALWAYS right about SENTENCES. It is FACES Waluigi struggles with. (FORESHADOWING. Waluigi DOES that. Waluigi is DEVASTATED by what Waluigi just foreshadowed.)

Then the TESTIMONY. Escaped the car. Returned to the Mages Guild. And the Guild — the GUILD, Luigi's OWN GUILD, the institution Luigi SERVED — SHUT THE DOOR IN HIS FACE. *"After everything I'd done for them! After all my loyalty! They wouldn't even let me inside!"* Voice CRACKING CLEAN OPEN. And Waluigi's note on this passage is Waluigi at Waluigi's ANGRIEST: the Guild shut its door on a man it had CONSCRIPTED, and I want the Guild's apologists to SIT WITH THAT before they lecture ANYONE about PROCEDURE. Whatever Luigi was by midnight — arsonist, victim, Mister L, ALL THREE AT ONCE — he was THEIR man at SUNDOWN. And they locked him out into the COLD with killers on EVERY ROAD.

The Koopa opened a door. DOORS ARE EVERYTHING. Doors are the WHOLE FILE. Waluigi said it. Waluigi MEANT it. I have had it CROSS-STITCHED. (I have NOT had it cross-stitched. I CANNOT cross-stitch. I TRIED. The filing does not mention the sampler. I mention that the filing does not mention the sampler. See SECTION ONE for my disclosure POLICY.)

And then I — gentle me, trying-my-best me, me with my volume at TEN PERCENT — say the WRONG THING. *"It's only been a few hours."* I KNEW it was wrong BEFORE the sentence finished LANDING. Waluigi's own filing CONVICTS Waluigi. And Luigi DETONATES: *"Only a FEW HOURS?! A few hours of being alone and scared is still TORTURE! A few hours of rejection stings just as bad as days would!"*

Waluigi takes the HIT. Waluigi does not DODGE it. Waluigi FILES it against HIMSELF. And I am RIGHT to, because — and here I drop the voice for EXACTLY one sentence, no jokes, no caps-lock armor: I had spent the whole evening telling Luigi his feelings were too big, and the bridge was about to show me what too big really looked like.

ABOVE US, WITHOUT WARNING, THE SKY CAUGHT FIRE.

Not the bridge. Not the LAKE. THE SKY. Fire RAINING DOWN in streaks and GOUTS. The bridge SHUDDERING. The lava CHURNING like something down there had woken up HUNGRY. Waluigi's voice is BACK. Waluigi's voice is LOUDER THAN EVER. I would like to REGISTER that the WEATHER has now JOINED the CONSPIRACY, and Waluigi wants a SEPARATE FILE for the SKY, and Waluigi is TAKING NAMES, and the FIRST NAME is GRAVITY'S.

sections.heading: Nine Seconds Of Mister L
sections.body:
The bridge starts dying in BOTH DIRECTIONS AT ONCE. Waluigi wants the SYMMETRY appreciated: cracks racing OUT from the middle with sounds like RIFLE SHOTS — *CRACK-crack-CRACK*, THREE cracks, Waluigi COUNTED, Waluigi counts DESTRUCTION the way other men count CHANGE — stone splitting toward Luigi at one end and toward ME at the OTHER, chunks calving off and dropping into the lava with fat SPITTING HISSES. The fire-rain LASHING down. The whole span GROANING. TILTING. Barely, then UNDENIABLY. Waluigi reports the tilt in TWO STAGES. Waluigi is PRECISE about TILT. Waluigi has been TILTED before. Waluigi RECOGNIZES tilt the way a sailor recognizes WEATHER.

*"Luigi, talk to me! What's happening?! Why is everything burning?! Who's attacking us?!"*

I am SCREAMING questions. I am STAGGERING. A crack OPENS BETWEEN MY BOOTS — Waluigi's boots are GRADUALLY BECOMING a CHARACTER IN THIS FILING, Waluigi is AWARE, I will give the boots their OWN SUBSECTION if they SURVIVE — and Luigi ANSWERS by RUNNING FOR THE AXE.

THE AXE. The CHEESE-ROOM AXE. The PROPOSITION. Luigi sprints across the FRACTURING bridge with the Fire Flower ABANDONED somewhere behind him — ABANDONED, the ordnance-with-petals just DROPPED, Waluigi NOTES the littering, Waluigi will CITE the littering — chunks dropping away on EITHER SIDE, straight for the far ledge and the weapon standing in the STONE. And my stomach drops THROUGH my boots. (The boots. CATCHING organs now. See ABOVE. I TOLD you they were becoming a character.)

*"You're trying to DESTROY the bridge?! Luigi, stop! If you cut it, we'll BOTH fall into the lava!"*

*"Luigi, what are you DOING?! If you swing that axe and cut this bridge, we're BOTH dead! Do you understand that?!"*

Waluigi SAYS it TWICE. Two warnings. ESCALATING. Waluigi believes in WARNING before CONSEQUENCE. Waluigi is CIVILIZED. Waluigi is CIVILIZED while STANDING ON A DISINTEGRATING BRIDGE OVER LAVA, which is MORE than most CIVILIZATIONS manage.

Luigi reaches the axe. Wraps BOTH HANDS around the haft. Looks BACK over his shoulder through the smoke and the fire-rain. And LAUGHS. A short, bright, WRONG little laugh — and I HEAR IT STILL, on BAD NIGHTS, UNDERNEATH OTHER SOUNDS. I say so. I do not SAY things like that LIGHTLY. My bad nights have a PLAYLIST and that laugh is TRACK ONE.

*"We're both dead?"*

Three words. DELIVERED like a man TESTING A RUMOR. And then Luigi HEAVES the axe out of the stone — *shRIING*, rock on steel, Waluigi TRANSCRIBES the sound EFFECT, Waluigi is Waluigi's OWN FOLEY ARTIST — stands there holding it with a calm that does NOT BELONG on his face, firelight running along the BLADE, and says it CLEARLY. Like a man INTRODUCING HIMSELF AT A DOOR:

*"It's Mister L now."*

Waluigi's response is IMMEDIATE and CORRECT: *"Mister L?! What kind of stupid name is THAT?! Put the axe DOWN!"* I critique the NAME. MID-CRISIS. Waluigi is a BRANDING EXPERT — Waluigi has designed at LEAST FOUR LOGOS — and I will NOT let a REBRAND go UNCHALLENGED just because there is LAVA INVOLVED. STANDARDS ARE STANDARDS. The name is STUPID. Waluigi FILED that it is stupid. Waluigi will DIE on this HILL even though the HILL IS CURRENTLY FALLING INTO LAVA.

And then — NOTHING. No SWING. Luigi's face CRUMPLES. The axe DROPS — CLANG on the stone — and Luigi goes DOWN after it, onto his KNEES, SOBBING: huge HEAVING terrified sobs, clutching his own ARMS. *"I-I don't know what's happening! The fire, the bridge... everything is falling apart! This wasn't supposed to happen! I didn't mean for any of this to go wrong!"*

NINE SECONDS. Waluigi COUNTED them later against the bridge sounds and Waluigi STANDS BY THE COUNT: nine seconds of Mister L, and then Luigi AGAIN, weeping. Said it like a TOAST. Like a CHRISTENING. And the christening lasted NINE SECONDS before the whole identity COLLAPSED crying onto hot rock. I watched the name get BORN and watched it FAIL, and BOTH happened before the bridge finished FALLING. And my note says REMEMBER THAT the next time the Regency waves a WARRANT with that letter on it. I am RIGHT. I am RIGHT and I KNOW I am right and I am FURIOUS that being right about this will NEVER BE ENOUGH. Whatever that name becomes later — WARRANT, WARNING, WARDROBE, my ALLITERATION, I am PROUD — it began as a DROWNING MAN'S last grab at AGENCY. And the archive should NEVER let the Regency pretend OTHERWISE.

sections.heading: The Yellow Cape Delivers, The Bridge Objects
sections.body:
The shaking starts BEFORE the figure appears. I want the ORDER OF OPERATIONS appreciated: FIRST the deep judder running the length of the dying bridge — teeth RATTLING, Waluigi's teeth have FILED a SEPARATE COMPLAINT — and THEN, through smoke boiling up off the lava in THICK BANKS, the SHAPE. Tall. Caped. SILENT. With a yellow cape hanging behind its back like a flag from a country NOBODY HAS DECLARED YET. Waluigi WROTE that line. Waluigi is STILL proud of that line. Waluigi considers that line the SINGLE BEST THING Waluigi has ever filed, and Waluigi has filed TEN THOUSAND PAPERS, and Waluigi is NOT being modest, because MODESTY is for people with FEWER PAPERS.

*"Wh— who's THERE?! Who the hell are you?! Show yourself!"*

I SPIN. I nearly LOSE MY FOOTING. I DEMAND identification the way I demand EVERYTHING — loudly, immediately, and from a structurally UNSOUND POSITION. The figure does NOT answer. The figure moves the way SMOKE moves — no hurry, no wasted motion, NO RESPECT for my volume — and reaches Luigi where Luigi kneels SOBBING by the dropped axe. And then it SPINS. Cape flaring out in a FULL WHIPPING CIRCLE. And the edge of that yellow cloth catches Luigi SQUARE and sends him FLYING sideways across the bridge LIKE A THROWN DOLL.

LIKE A THROWN DOLL. Waluigi's simile. Waluigi APOLOGIZES for the simile's ACCURACY. Luigi — the REAL Luigi, the burnt-fingers Luigi, the man I have spent the evening SCREAMING AT and the last two hours WORRYING ABOUT — gets LAUNCHED by LAUNDRY. By FASHION. By a CAPE, deployed with such CASUAL PRECISION that I understand INSTANTLY: resistance is COMEDY. The filing says so. I UNDERLINED it. I framed the UNDERLINE.

*"LUIGI!"*

Luigi fetches up at the VERY EDGE of the span. HALF OVER THE DROP. Staring UP. And the figure stands OVER him — FACELESS in the SMOKE — and extends ONE HAND. And in the hand:

A FOLDED NOTE. One fold. Contents UNVERIFIED TO THIS DAY. I have spent YEARS on this note. I have a SEPARATE FILE for this note. I have an EXHIBIT TAG for this note that says, in so many words, I NEVER GOT TO READ IT. And I am FINE. I am CALM. I am TOTALLY CALM about the NOTE. (I am NOT calm about the note. NOBODY is calm about the note. The NOTE is the reason I DRINK — I do not DRINK, I AUDIT, but if I DRANK, it would be ABOUT THE NOTE.)

*"Luigi... read it. Read the note."* Flat. MECHANICAL. Eerie in its CALM. Each word placed LIKE A TILE. *"This changes everything."*

NINE WORDS. I COUNTED. Two sentences. The courier's WHOLE SPEECH. And then — THEN — the figure holds still ONE BEAT LONGER. One beat. Long enough for me to understand, with COLD CERTAINTY, that it knew EXACTLY where I was standing and had CHOSEN NOT TO CARE. I have been IGNORED by EXPERTS. I have been dismissed by ROYALTY. I have NEVER been so COMPLETELY, so PROFESSIONALLY, so SURGICALLY disregarded by ANYONE, and I am TAKING IT PERSONALLY, and I will take it personally FOREVER, because I was STANDING RIGHT THERE.

And then it RAN. Off across the COLLAPSING bridge. Gone into the smoke between one breath and the NEXT, cape and ALL, as if it had NEVER NEEDED THE BRIDGE. As if the bridge were a SUGGESTION. As if GRAVITY were OPTIONAL and the courier had OPTED OUT. My aside reads the sequence back like a DELIVERY MANIFEST: the shaking announces the courier, the courier demonstrates, the goods change hands, the courier exits stage SMOKE. I have received REGISTERED POST with LESS ceremony and MORE paperwork. I want the PAPERWORK. I ALWAYS want the PAPERWORK. There is NO paperwork. THERE IS NEVER PAPERWORK. The slab gives a sharp CRACK and begins to TIP TOWARD THE LAVA. Of COURSE it does. I am STILL ON IT.

sections.heading: Its A-Me, Or: Five Words Through Burnt Lips
sections.body:
I do not HESITATE. I LUNGE across the breaking bridge with my arm OUTSTRETCHED, stone crumbling under my BOOTS — the boots, STILL in the filing, Waluigi PROMISED them a SUBSECTION and Waluigi KEEPS PROMISES — reaching for Luigi as the slab under Luigi gives WAY.

I MISS. My fingers close on HOT EMPTY AIR. And Luigi goes DOWN through the wreckage with the NOTE CLUTCHED TO HIS CHEST, and then the whole MIDDLE of the bridge goes with a roar LIKE THE WORLD CLEARING ITS THROAT — Waluigi's simile, Waluigi's THROAT metaphors, Waluigi is FALLING and STILL TRANSCRIBING — and I am falling TOO, into smoke so THICK I cannot see MY OWN GLOVES.

*"LUIGI! NO! This can't be happening... THIS CAN'T BE HAPPENING!"*

I fall through CHOKING GREY that BURNS going down. I cough hard enough to DOUBLE OVER MID-AIR. I scream Luigi's name into the smoke until my voice SHREDS. And the fall ends the way falls end in that compound: NOT on rock, but IN the lake system. I come down SPRAWLING on a slab of FLOATING DEBRIS riding the slow lava current. GASPING. Half-blind. ALIVE. I am ALIVE and I am ANGRY ABOUT IT, because being alive means I have to KEEP FILING, and I would like a MOMENT, but the LAVA does not GIVE moments, the lava gives CURRENTS.

*"Luigi! Can you hear me?! Say something! Please... if you're alive, talk to me!"*

NOTHING. Only the crawl of the current and the POP of the lava and MY OWN coughing. And then — through a tear in the smoke — I SEE IT. THE SHOE. Luigi's shoe. Sitting UPRIGHT on a nearby rock. AS IF ITS OWNER HAD JUST STEPPED OUT OF IT.

I am going to need a MOMENT with the SHOE. Waluigi's own note spends an ENTIRE PARAGRAPH on the shoe, and Waluigi is RIGHT TO, because the shoe is UPRIGHT. UPRIGHT. ON ITS OWN ROCK. I understand the FACE — fire does what fire DOES — but the SHOE was sitting there AS IF PLACED. Either the current has a STAGE MANAGER'S instincts, I say, or SOMEBODY in that smoke ARRANGED THE SCENE before I ARRIVED. I filed the shoe as DEBRIS. I think about it as STAGING. The file and I DISAGREE, and the file is WINNING ON POINTS, and I am TELLING YOU THIS because I believe in DISCLOSING MY LOSSES.

Beyond the shoe: ANOTHER rock. And on it: the NOTE. Smoke-darkened. INTACT. Riding the same slow current toward a distant THUNDER that I now understand, with SINKING HORROR, is a WATERFALL. Of LAVA. Of COURSE it is a waterfall. Of COURSE it is lava. I do not even BREAK STRIDE. My stride is UNBREAKABLE. My stride has TENURE.

And then — a HAND. Over the edge of MY OWN slab. A WHITE GLOVE, scorched GREY at the fingers, GRIPPING. The slab TILTS. I FREEZE. The glove HAULS. A head rises: a face HALF-CHARRED BLACK, blistered and RAW down one side, the mustache SINGED TO A RUIN. And the ruined mouth MOVES. And the voice comes out THIN AS PAPER:

*"Its a-me. Your best friend."*

FIVE WORDS. I COUNTED. Five words through BURNT LIPS on a rock in a RIVER OF FIRE. I have been threatened by WARLORDS, sued by WARIO, and audited by MY OWN REFLECTION — my aside LISTS all three, I ITEMIZE TRAUMA — and NOTHING has ever LANDED the way those five words LANDED. If that was ACTING, I say, strike my name from the auditors' ROLL, because I CANNOT tell the difference and I NO LONGER WANT TO.

And Luigi does not WAIT for me to recover. Luigi hauls himself up, staggers UPRIGHT, and JUMPS — CLEAN ACROSS OPEN LAVA — to the rock with the NOTE. And snatches it UP. With BURNT FINGERS. And unfolds it. And something slips OUT OF THE FOLD into his palm: a TANUKI LEAF. Golden-brown. WHOLE. Shimmering faintly in the firelight LIKE A COIN AT THE BOTTOM OF A FOUNTAIN. (Waluigi's simile. Waluigi's COIN metaphors. Waluigi sees CURRENCY EVERYWHERE. Waluigi is an AUDITOR. EVERYTHING IS CURRENCY.)

Luigi presses the leaf FLAT. And the change takes him like a STRUCK MATCH: fur, ears, TAIL, the whole tanuki rig blooming out of a HALF-BURNT MAN, and then he is SPRINTING full tilt across the floating debris, leaping rock to rock with the waterfall thundering closer, and then — the WORST thing yet — Luigi spreads his arms and FLIES. WOBBLING. Climbing into the SMOKE. And I RUN after him, I JUMP, my fingers close around Luigi's ANKLE MID-AIR, I HAUL DOWN with ALL MY WEIGHT — *"Got you! You idiot! You reckless idiot!"* — and THAT is when MY PHONE RINGS.

*"Oh, come ON, seriously?! Who even calls right now?!"*

It is WARIO. It is ALWAYS Wario. And I answer it — one hand on the phone, one hand on a KICKING ANKLE, over OPEN LAVA — and the impossibility lands on me ALL AT ONCE: a Luigi DANGLING by one ankle versus a Luigi STANDING NEXT TO WARIO being EXTREMELY HELPFUL. Both statements. SAME moment. I am holding the phone in ONE hand and a flying burn victim in the OTHER. And I am about to learn what KIND of night this REALLY is.

sections.heading: Two Luigis, One Phone Call, Zero Good Options
sections.body:
*"We found Luigi! Get your butt over here before Wario shows him the true Wario style!"*

WARIO'S VOICE. TRIUMPHANT. Over a phone I am holding ONE-HANDED while the OTHER hand grips a KICKING ANKLE over OPEN LAVA. And my brain — Waluigi's MAGNIFICENT, AUDIT-TRAINED, ITEMIZING brain — does the thing Waluigi's brain does BEST: it REFUSES. *"What? You FOUND Luigi?! But he's RIGHT HERE with me!"* Because the Luigi at the end of MY ARM is real, is BURNT, is KICKING, is DANGLING OVER LAVA RIGHT NOW, and Wario is TALKING about ANOTHER ONE like Luigi's come in SIX-PACKS.

*"How can that be him when he is standing right HERE? Come on, let me put-a him on the phone—"*

And then a voice comes through the speaker that STOPS MY BLOOD. Luigi's voice. UNMISTAKABLY. CHEERFUL. UNHURT. Talking on Wario's phone while the burnt ORIGINAL kicks weakly at the end of my arm. Waluigi says Waluigi's blood STOPPED. Waluigi is NOT speaking METAPHORICALLY. Waluigi's CIRCULATION has FILED INCIDENT REPORTS about that phone call. Waluigi's HEART — the ESCAPE-ATTEMPTING heart, see SECTION FOUR — MISSED A BEAT, and Waluigi FELT it miss, and Waluigi has NOT FORGIVEN IT.

*"Huh? That... that can't be real. That's impossible."*

The rocks are VISIBLY ACCELERATING toward the falls. I NOTICE. I ALWAYS notice the GEOLOGY. I am being CARRIED TOWARD A LAVA WATERFALL and I am MONITORING THE CURRENT SPEED, because I am a PROFESSIONAL, and professionals MONITOR. And Wario comes back on, talking FAST: *"Hey, so here's the deal — Luigi was hiding at the Mages Guild. We got fake passes, went in, and kidnapped him."*

I need this REPEATED. I need this SLOWER. *"Hold up. Slow down. You're saying you faked passes and INFILTRATED the Mages Guild? And KIDNAPPED Luigi? But I'm HOLDING him right now!"*

And the line CRACKLES. And DIES. And I am SHOUTING into STATIC: *"Hey! Hello?! Answer me! Damn it... who were we even talking to?"*

WHO WERE WE EVEN TALKING TO. I ASK. The filing ASKS. NOBODY ANSWERS. The paper does NOT say — not yet, not for PAGES — and I want you to SIT IN THAT. I sat in it. I sat in it on a TILTING ROCK over LAVA with spray STINGING my face and the falls' white-orange curtain VISIBLE through the smoke AHEAD. And Luigi — the REAL one, the BURNT one, the one at the end of MY ARM — had gone LIMP. Shallow BREATHING. UNSTABLE. Gone UNDER.

*"Luigi... come on, stay with me! Wake up! PLEASE wake up! I can't lose you like this!"*

I SHAKE him. I SHOUT. I shake him AGAIN. The roar SWALLOWS everything. *"This isn't happening... we can't die like this! Not here, not now!"*

And Luigi's eyes FLUTTER OPEN. At the SAME INSTANT their rock hits FASTER WATER and TILTS VIOLENTLY, slamming SIDEWAYS into another slab with a jolt that nearly throws us BOTH clear. *"Luigi! You're awake! The rock's tilting — hold on TIGHT!"*

And then the current takes Luigi's slab and TEARS it sideways. Luigi goes FLYING off our shared rock onto a SEPARATE one — already moving FASTER than anything I can match — SHRINKING into the smoke toward the light at the falls' lip. Too FAR. Too FAST. A jump I CANNOT make. And I look at the gap. And I do the ARITHMETIC. And I say it:

*"I'm sorry, Luigi! If I try, we'll both get swept away! I have to... stay here."*

I LET GO. I want that written PLAINLY where nobody can soften it LATER. And here, for the only time in this filing, I drop the voice entirely. No jokes. No armor. Three sentences, plain: Every auditor in the building told me the arithmetic was correct. None of them has ever stood on a shore afterward shouting a name at a moat. The arithmetic does not cover that part, and it never will, and I have stopped asking it to.

The current takes me. Spits me out the SIDE CHANNEL. Onto a CALM lava shore. The moat. OUTSIDE the compound walls. Ground level. SOLID DIRT under my boots. No Luigi. No ROCK. No NOTE. Just the compound LOOMING ahead and the moat lapping QUIET ORANGE at my feet. And I KICK a rock hard enough to HURT MY OWN FOOT — my foot, my PAIN, I ITEMIZE — and shout at NOTHING: *"Luigi... where are you? That idiot got swept away! He could be dead for all I know! I just lost him! After everything!"*

And then my phone RINGS. AGAIN. Of COURSE it does. My phone has IMPECCABLE timing. My phone should RUN the ARCHIVE.

sections.heading: The Smile Opens The Gate
sections.body:
I SNATCH the phone up. *"Damn it, this AGAIN?! What?!"* And Wario's voice comes through PANICKED — a NEW flavor, Waluigi NOTES, Waluigi CATALOGUES Wario's panic the way a SOMMELIER catalogues WINE — and the panic says: the Luigi they HAD told them where MARIO was. They are ON THEIR WAY THERE. *"He said he was near Bowser's compound"* — the compound I am STANDING OUTSIDE OF, soaked, burnt, and ALONE — *"anyway, time is money, we are headed over there."*

TIME IS MONEY. Waluigi HEARS that phrase. Waluigi has HEARD that phrase from Wario approximately NINE THOUSAND TIMES. Waluigi wants it STRUCK FROM THE RECORD and also TATTOOED ON WARIO'S FOREHEAD so I can POINT AT IT during FUTURE DISASTERS.

And my thought arrives FULLY FORMED and FREEZING COLD: the Luigi I just SAW was burned and barely CONSCIOUS. That Luigi could NOT have told ANYONE ANYTHING useful. *"Wario, listen to me carefully. The Luigi I just had was half-dead and couldn't even talk. There's no way he gave you Mario's location. Someone is LYING."*

SOMEONE IS LYING. I SAY IT. I am RIGHT. Waluigi is ALWAYS right about LYING — Waluigi detects lies the way SHARKS detect BLOOD, at DISTANCE, through STATIC — and I do not yet know HOW right I am, which is my FAVORITE KIND of right: the kind with ROOM TO GET WORSE.

Then MONA is on the line. Voice THIN through the crackle. Trying AUDIBLY not to panic. *"Waluigi... we need to talk. We found Mario... but something is very wrong. The Luigi we're with... he's not acting like himself. He gave us Mario's location too easily. It feels off."*

TOO EASILY. I SEIZE those two words like a LIFE RAFT. TOO EASILY is the EXACT tell every auditor is trained to HEAR. Intelligence that arrives TOO EASILY is not INTELLIGENCE. It is BAIT. And Mona — Mona, RIDING IN A CAR WITH THE THING, in the DARK, at SPEED — told me it was WRONG. Waluigi's filing calls it the BRAVEST record of the night and Waluigi wants Mona CREDITED, and Waluigi is RIGHT, and Waluigi is STILL crediting her, YEARS later, in THIS paragraph, because CREDIT COMPOUNDS and Waluigi PAYS INTEREST.

*"What do you mean, not acting like himself? Did he say anything weird? Or move strangely?"* And my mind is already RACING down the list — CLONE, DUPLICATE, IMPOSTOR, WORSE — I KEEP A LIST, I ALWAYS keep a list, my list has SUB-BULLETS.

*"Mona, hold on a second—"*

HEADLIGHTS. Above the moat. On the compound road. Wario's CAR, rolling in with its BRIGHTS ON. And IN IT — I nearly DROP the phone INTO THE LAVA — LUIGI. Standing-height. BLUE-CLAD. Perfectly HEALTHY. WAVING. TALLER somehow. CHEERFUL. Nothing out of place EXCEPT EVERYTHING.

I DUCK behind the moat rocks. I WATCH. The car crunches to a STOP at the gate — Wario driving, Mona, Ashley, and Jimmy T crammed in around the WAVING FIGURE — and they talk to the GUARD. THE SAME GUARD. The getup-mocking, two-minute-issuing, button-clicking GUARD. And then the BLUE Luigi strolls up to the window HIMSELF. Smiles ONE slow smile.

And the guard OPENS THE GATE. Just LIKE THAT. NO button drama. NO shouting. NO two-minute HAZING. I BANGED on that window until my hand RANG and got INTERROGATED about MY OUTFIT. This thing SHOWED ITS TEETH and the IRON swung WIDE like it was EXPECTED. I filed BOTH readings — most CORRUPT checkpoint in the kingdom, or the compound KNEW ITS OWN ASSET ON SIGHT — and I BELIEVE the second one the way I believe in GRAVITY. Which is to say: COMPLETELY, BITTERLY, and with EXTENSIVE DOCUMENTATION.

*"They're letting them in? Just like that?"*

And for ONE SPLIT SECOND the blue figure turns its head toward my hiding place. And the face DOESN'T MOVE RIGHT. Too STIFF. Too CALM. A smile LIKE PAINT. I see it. I will NEVER UNSEE it. I have TRIED to unsee it. My EFFORTS are DOCUMENTED and DENIED.

*"That smile... that wasn't Luigi. That was something else."*

I DIAL Wario back with SHAKING fingers. *"Wario, what did you just let inside?! That wasn't Luigi! That thing smiled like a creepy robot — why would security just open up for it?!"* And then — THE BANG. A deep concussive BOOM from INSIDE the compound, shaking DUST off the moat rocks. And on its heels: Wario's CAR ALARM. Wailing into the NIGHT. My favorite DUET. EXPLOSION plus ALARM. I would like it NOTED that the night now has a SOUNDTRACK and I did NOT APPROVE IT.

The entrance wall BURSTS OUTWARD in rubble and DUST. And through the wreckage — UNHURRIED, HUMMING — walks the BLUE Luigi. UNTOUCHED. UNBOTHERED. Smiling that same EMPTY painted smile. He STOPS in the open. Still HUMMING his little TUNE. And begins PEELING OFF the blue overalls. UNDERNEATH: the familiar GREEN SHIRT and JEANS. The costume comes away LIKE A HUSK.

*"You really are an idiot,"* he says pleasantly, to everyone and NO ONE. *"All of you."*

I have been called WORSE. I have been called worse BY BETTER. But I have NEVER been called an idiot by a HUSK, and I am ADDING IT TO THE LIST. The list is LONG. The list has SUB-BULLETS. The HUSK is filed under H.

sections.heading: The Confession Is A Cover Story With Applause
sections.body:
What follows, in the dust of the burst wall, is the LONGEST CONFESSION I have ever heard delivered as COMEDY. Waluigi says so. Waluigi has HEARD confessions — Waluigi COLLECTS confessions, Waluigi has ALBUMS — and this one is the LONGEST, and it is DELIVERED like a STAND-UP SET, and I am the AUDIENCE, and I did NOT buy a TICKET, and I want a REFUND.

*"Wow! You guys really fell for it, huh? I mean... seriously? Wario didn't even question me once!"*

The thing GIGGLES. Light. MUSICAL. WRONG in a way that raises the HAIRS on MY ARMS. Waluigi's hairs have STANDING ORDERS to report WRONGNESS, and they are REPORTING, and Waluigi is LISTENING. *"And Mona! Ashley! Jimmy T! Oh man, you all just handed Wario right to Bowser on a silver platter."*

IT TILTS ITS HEAD. THE SMILE NEVER MOVES. Waluigi wants those two sentences READ ALOUD at EVERY security briefing FOREVER. A head that TILTS while the smile STAYS is not a FACE. It is a MASK with a NECK. Waluigi KNOWS masks. Waluigi has WORN masks. Waluigi's masks have BETTER RANGE.

And ON it goes. Pacing the RUBBLE. TWIRLING its own HAIR. Savoring EACH NAME — Wario's EXCITEMENT, Mona's GRATITUDE, Ashley UPSET, Jimmy T SILENT — like a CRITIC savoring a MENU. *"It was simple, my plan, really. After I saw you all running like headless chickens I thought I would help you find Luigi and Mario. Get your happy ending."* ANOTHER giggle. High and JOYLESS. *"My plan worked perfectly. You all ran around like idiots chasing clues while Bowser got exactly what he wanted."*

HEADLESS CHICKENS. I have been called WORSE. (See SECTION TEN. The HUSK. I CROSS-REFERENCE INSULTS.) But I NOTE the phrase, because I note EVERYTHING, and what I note is THIS: the confession tells EVERYTHING about the OPERATION and NOTHING about the OPERATOR. No NAME. No HANDLER. No PRICE. My filing says it PLAINLY — that is not BRAGGING, that is a COVER STORY with the serial numbers PERFORMING — and I am RIGHT, and I am RIGHT IN THE FILING AND RIGHT IN THIS PARAGRAPH, which is DOUBLE RIGHTNESS, which is my FAVORITE NUMBER.

*"You really thought Bowser wouldn't have spies? That he wouldn't send someone in disguised as one of you? You guys are WAY too trusting."*

WAY too trusting. WAY. The thing says WAY, and I HEAR it, and from inside the compound comes SHOUTING — panicked, MULTIPLYING — and the thing CLAPS ITS HANDS IN DELIGHT. *"Ohhh, and now the screaming starts! I can hear Wario yelling! Hahaha!"*

IT CLAPS. AT SCREAMING. I want the JURY to note the CLAPPING. And I want the record to show what my filing shows: the giggle NEVER CHANGES. Same notes. Same TEMPO. No matter WHAT room it is in. Giggling at its OWN plan. Giggling at screaming it CAUSED. Giggling LATER with BLOOD ON ITS LIP. A person laughs because something is FUNNY. That thing laughed the way a MUSIC BOX plays. THE LAUGH WAS PART OF THE COSTUME. Same as the OVERALLS. And it came off ABOUT AS EASILY.

It NEVER NOTICED the car starting. I SAVOR this sentence. I SAVOR it the way the THING savored NAMES. Wario — out of the wreckage, behind the WHEEL, with MURDER IN HIS EYES — REVERSES straight into it. *THUMP.* The confession ends MID-GIGGLE. The impostor sprawls in the DUST clutching its SHOULDER.

*"OW!! What is wrong with you?! You could've killed me!!"*

*"I COULD'VE killed you?"* Wario is ALREADY CLIMBING OUT. Knuckles cracking LIKE POPCORN. *"YOU could have killed ME!"*

I LOVE this exchange. I have MEMORIZED this exchange. I RECITE this exchange at PARTIES. (I am NOT invited to parties. I RECITE ANYWAY. I recite to the MIRROR. The mirror has FILED a complaint. PENDING.)

sections.heading: YOU CHEATED: The Gambit Is Born
sections.body:
And then THE FIGHT. Short. UGLY. SIX-AGAINST-ONE. Wario LEADS with a haymaker the impostor DUCKS — *"Slow as hell! Is this all you've got?!"* — and then I CHARGE IN, and from there it gets WORSE for the fraud, because Mona and Jimmy T PILE OUT of the car, and ASHLEY steps forward with her face LIKE WINTER and says NOTHING AT ALL. NOTHING. And the filing says the SILENCE frightened the impostor MORE than the shouting HAD. Waluigi BELIEVES IT. Waluigi has BEEN on the receiving end of Ashley's SILENCE. Waluigi's SILENCE-RECEIVING record is EXTENSIVE and UNDEFEATED. NOBODY beats the SILENCE.

*CRACK.* Wario's fist CONNECTS. The smile comes OFF for one BEAUTIFUL half-second. HALF A SECOND. Waluigi TREASURES it. Waluigi has FRAMED it. It hangs in Waluigi's OFFICE next to Waluigi's FOUR LOGOS. And Ashley RAISES her witch's broom — *"What the—?! A witches broom?!"* — and the interrogation BEGINS: Wario with a FISTFUL OF COLLAR, Ashley with the broom COCKED, Mona TWISTING one arm behind its back, Jimmy T TAKING the other.

And THEN. I STEP FORWARD. I point ONE LONG FINGER at the thing wearing MY informant's FACE. And I shout with ALL the fury of the bridge, the falls, the moat, and the LOST SHOE:

*"YOU CHEATED!"*

THE FIRST CHEATER'S GAMBIT. EVER DEPLOYED. Waluigi SAID IT and Waluigi MEANT IT and Waluigi would say it AGAIN in front of ANY tribunal in ANY kingdom. That thing did not BEAT us. It did not OUTFIGHT us or OUTTHINK us. It MARKED the cards, STACKED the deck, and DEALT ITSELF my friend's FACE — and there is EXACTLY ONE auditor's answer to a marked deck, which is to NAME IT OUT LOUD. The crew takes it up LIKE A WAR CRY — *"Yeah, you CHEATED!"* — and the Gambit is BORN on a pile of RUBBLE at MIDNIGHT, and it has NEVER ONCE been deployed against an HONEST opponent SINCE. Waluigi SWEARS it. Waluigi SWEARS it on Waluigi's FOUR LOGOS and Waluigi's ONE SHOE-GRIEVANCE.

The reckoning ROLLS ON: a Wario HEADBUTT — *CRUNCH*, blood from the NOSE — Ashley's broom coming DOWN across its back with a magical *WHAM* — BOTH arms PINNED — FIVE furious faces CLOSING IN. *"You gonna talk now, or are we gonna have to beat the truth out of you?! We're waiting."* And: *"I'm NOT telling you anything! Go ahead! Hit me all you want! I don't care!"*

So ASHLEY MOUNTS HER BROOM. And the impostor takes ONE LOOK UP at her — HOVERING — and its whole PERFORMANCE SHATTERS into raw PANIC: *"Wha— NO! Let me GO!"* And Ashley, COLDLY, from ABOVE: *"You have ONE last chance. Tell us who you are and why you impersonated Luigi."* And: *"I-I'm not saying anything!"*

Ashley reaches DOWN. Takes a FISTFUL of its SHIRT. And LIFTS. And what happens on that RIDE is attested ONLY by its ENDING — the paper does NOT say, I do NOT SPECULATE, NOBODY in this building has authenticated a SINGLE SECOND of that flight — and the ENDING is this: ONE HOUR LATER, outside the compound walls, the impostor lies UNCONSCIOUS. TIED hand and foot. OUT OF SMILES AT LAST. WAH.

sections.heading: Three Steps, Zero Splitting Up
sections.body:
ONE HOUR LATER. Outside the compound. The group stands around in the COLD with an unconscious PRISONER and a problem NOBODY wants to say FIRST. Waluigi KNOWS that SILENCE. Waluigi has STOOD in that silence. That silence is the sound of SIX PEOPLE doing the SAME ARITHMETIC and HATING the ANSWER. Wario HUFFS, arms CROSSED. Mona rubs her TEMPLES. Jimmy T KICKS A ROCK hard enough to SKITTER it off the wall. (Waluigi kicked a rock EARLIER. See SECTION NINE. Rock-kicking is CONTAGIOUS. Waluigi has FILED a public-health NOTICE. PENDING.)

And I TELL THEM. Finally. FULLY. The OTHER Luigi. The AMBUSH. The AXE. The YELLOW CAPE. The NOTE. The LEAF. The FALLS. The BURNS. The SHOE sitting upright on its rock. THE HAND LETTING GO. I tell it ALL, and my voice does NOT BREAK — my voice NEVER breaks, my voice is BUILT TO HOLD — except where it DOES, and where it does, I LEAVE IT IN THE FILING, because I am HONEST about MY BREAKS.

*"That Luigi I saved from falling into the lava... he was barely alive. He couldn't talk, could barely move. He had burns everywhere and looked half-dead. There's no way that guy could've been lying to us or tricking anyone."*

*"So... there were two Luigis?"* Mona says SLOWLY. *"One real and one fake?"*

*"And then THAT thing showed up with Wario, acting all cheerful and normal!"* I JAB a finger at the tied bundle. *"That thing didn't even look scared when the compound exploded! The real Luigi would've been freaking out!"*

THE REAL LUIGI WOULD'VE BEEN FREAKING OUT. I say it. I MEAN it. Waluigi has SEEN the real Luigi FREAK OUT — Waluigi has a whole ARCHIVE of Luigi FREAKING OUT, Waluigi could CURATE an EXHIBITION — and the ABSENCE of freaking-out is DIAGNOSTIC. The paper does not need to say it. I say it. Ashley NODS, eyes on the prisoner: the real one was probably STILL HURT somewhere while the impostor TRICKED them.

And then WARIO EXPLODES. Pacing. *"So where the hell is the REAL Luigi now?! If that fake one was with us this whole time... then what happened to the REAL one?! Was he captured?! Did Bowser take him somewhere else?! We need to find the real Luigi! We have to split up—"*

*"Splitting up got us into this mess in the first place."*

MONA. QUIETLY. And the WHOLE GROUP goes STILL. Because she is RIGHT and EVERYONE KNOWS IT. Wario DEFLATES mid-stride. Waluigi has SEEN Wario deflate. Waluigi TREASURES every instance. Waluigi keeps a DEFLATION LOG. This entry is Waluigi's FAVORITE.

*"Well then how the hell are we gonna find him?! We don't even know where to start!"*

And I hold up ONE FINGER. The crew TURNS. Wario mid-FUME. Mona HOPEFUL. Ashley already gripping her broom LIKE STEP ONE. Jimmy T with one eyebrow RAISED. And I — soaked to the BONE, lava in MY BOOTS, running on NOTHING — issue the most PROFESSIONAL plan I have EVER issued:

STEP ONE: interrogate the fake Luigi PROPERLY. Find out who SENT him and WHY. STEP TWO: check the SECURITY FOOTAGE from Bowser's compound. If the fake came in with Wario EARLIER, maybe they FILMED something useful. STEP THREE: start checking the REST of the compound THEMSELVES. Every ROOM. Every HALL. Every NOOK and CRANNY. Find their way through the DAMN PLACE and don't LEAVE until they've SEARCHED IT ALL.

INTERROGATE. INVESTIGATE. INVADE. In THAT order. NO splitting up. NO more hunches at MIDNIGHT. Mona's eyes SHINE. Ashley SMILES — a small COLD thing, but a SMILE. Jimmy T GRINS slyly. Wario cracks his knuckles LIKE A MAN ACCEPTING A CONTRACT. And then I hold out MY PALM — and Wario, for ONCE IN HIS LIFE, WITHOUT ARGUMENT, fishes the forged Guild pass from his POCKET and slaps it into the GLOVE. Souvenir of the infiltration. Evidence of the FELONY. The only paper the night produced that ANYONE was allowed to READ. I FILE it. I EXHIBIT it. I have GIVEN IT A PROP NUMBER and I am NOTASHAMED. (I am a LITTLE ashamed. The SHAME is filed SEPARATELY.)

And behind them, in the rubble of the burst wall, the BLUE OVERALLS lie where the impostor TOSSED them: EMPTY. BRIGHT. GRINNING WITH NOBODY INSIDE. I say: if that is not this whole night folded into ONE OBJECT, I do not know WHAT is. I am RIGHT. I am right about OBJECTS the way I am right about SENTENCES. It is FACES I struggle with. (See SECTION FIVE. I CALL BACK. I ALWAYS call back. My callbacks have CALLBACKS.)

sections.heading: The Verdict: A Prisoner, A Plan, And A Grief
sections.body:
And now — the VERDICT. Waluigi's filing ends with FIVE numbered points, and Waluigi is going to CONDENSE them, because Waluigi RESPECTS the READER'S TIME (Waluigi does NOT respect the reader's time, Waluigi has written EIGHT THOUSAND WORDS, but Waluigi SAYS it, and SAYING it COUNTS): TWO operations, not one — desperation with a borrowed axe, tradecraft with a rehearsed smile — sharing a compound and an HOUR but not a COMMANDER, UNLESS the commander is Bowser running BOTH SIDES of the board, which the file CANNOT prove and I CANNOT STOP suspecting. MISTER L lasted NINE SECONDS, and the archive should NEVER let the Regency pretend it was ANYTHING but a drowning man's last grab at AGENCY. The NOTE is the most important UNREAD document in the building, and the leaf was TRANSPORT, not MESSAGE, which means the MESSAGE is still IN PLAY, in the pocket of a MISSING MAN. MONA was right FIRST and ASHLEY finished it, and the women in the car are the reason anyone has a PRISONER instead of a CRATER. And the RECOMMENDATION: run the three steps IN ORDER, starting with the PRISONER, before Bowser's people come BACK for him — because a smile that OPENS GATES is an ASSET, and ASSETS GET RETRIEVED.

Waluigi's boots STILL smell of sulfur. The compound has filed NO repair order. Bowser's office has said NOTHING. The Guild has acknowledged NOTHING — not the passes, not the ABDUCTION, not the SHUT DOOR that STARTED it. And no search of the falls' OUTFLOW has yet been FILED, and the archive notes that ABSENCE with ALARM, and I note it with something HOTTER than alarm, something I do not have a NUMBERED POINT for.

I went to that gate on a HUNCH. I came back with a PRISONER, a PLAN, and a GRIEF. The hunch was RIGHT. The prisoner is NAMELESS. The plan is THREE STEPS. And the grief — the grief is the part I do not ITEMIZE. WAH.

commentaries.title: The Garden Above the Fire
commentaries.subtitle: In Which Waluigi Finds The Real Luigi, Answers The Wrong Brother's Question, And Hates How Right The Feeling Was
commentaries.filed: 5 Aethel, 1040 BF — filed from the desk after the clinic report, with sulfur still in the margins
commentaries.pullQuote: Luigi asked whether they were still superstars. Mario was not there. Waluigi answered anyway, and Waluigi will answer again if the archive needs to hear it louder.
commentaries.standfirst: The rescue file closes the compound chase, and because Waluigi was not beside this story, Waluigi was INSIDE it, the cut cannot pretend to be distant. This is the fake Luigi coughing water, the hallway argument reported by a liar, the yellow cape, the lava moat, Kat and Ana on the rocks, Luigi burned and alive, the sentence about the star, Dr. Toad's clinic, and the line Waluigi said because silence would have been worse.

sections.heading: First We Wake The Wrong Luigi, Because Of COURSE We Do
sections.body:
Waluigi begins where the rescue file begins: with water in the wrong Luigi's face. Mona pours it, Wario looms, Ashley has the broom ready, Jimmy T cracks his knuckles, and Waluigi has the pen out before Waluigi remembers deciding to take it out. That is not a detail for decoration. That is how Waluigi knows the night has crossed from fight into filing. A weapon goes in one hand, a record goes in the other, and if the world wants Waluigi to choose, the world should stop producing suspects who wear Luigi's face like a costume bought in a hurry.

The impostor wakes tied, coughing, and trying to locate which kind of trouble he has fallen into. Answer: ALL KINDS. Wario says wake up now, which is less a sentence than a building falling on you. Mona says he has explaining to do. Ashley does not need to say anything because a witch with a broom pointed at your future is ALREADY GRAMMAR. Jimmy T supplies the little dry knuckle sound. Waluigi supplies the part history remembers.

Then the false Luigi says, *"Alright, alright... I get it. I'll talk."*
